findings.title: Branch protection and required checks are plan-gated, so `validate` is advisory
findings.note: Owner-accepted with compensating controls (CODEOWNERS, PR template, doctrine). Carried from focused run CI-P2-001 / 20261003 CI-P1-002.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision D: upgrade to GitHub Pro/Team and apply the recorded payload, or per-merge attest that validate was green and treat direct pushes as break-glass.

findings.title: Auto-merge workflow holds broad write scope and merges without pinning the checked commit
findings.note: Carried from focused run CI-P3-001 / 20261003 CI-P2-002; still present at f9cb67d.
findings.recommendation: Add `--match-head-commit` to `gh pr merge`, scope permissions to the minimum, and add an environment/required-review gate to the auto-merge job.

findings.title: Dependabot covers only GitHub Actions; Python CI deps and container images are unmanaged
findings.note: Carried from focused run DEP-P2-001; still present at f9cb67d.
findings.recommendation: Add pip/uv and docker ecosystems to `.github/dependabot.yml`, or add `renovate.json` with digest pinning, preserving the hash-pin policy for CI deps.

findings.title: Release and SBOM artifacts are integrity-checked but unsigned (SLSA ~0-1)
findings.note: Carried from focused run SUPPLY-P2-001; still present at f9cb67d.
findings.recommendation: Implement D1: an owner-held ed25519/GPG signature over `sbom/SBOM_MANIFEST.sha256` with the public key published and the manifest hash bound in `PACKAGE_DIGEST.txt`, or use GitHub artifact attestations.

findings.title: Public-facing routers rely only on Cloudflare Access; `ntfy-auth` is dead config
findings.note: Carried from focused run SEC-P2-001; not yet fixed at f9cb67d.
findings.recommendation: Add origin authentication to public routers (or record a testable owner acceptance); delete or wire `ntfy-auth`.

findings.title: All 20 inherited credentials remain PENDING rotation; 28 vendored scripts source credential files wholesale
findings.note: Tooling (rotation_status.py) added earlier; rotation execution itself remains outstanding.
findings.recommendation: Execute the documented rotation order with name-only evidence and negative tests; migrate the 28 scripts to single-key reads.

findings.title: [DEP] trivy not installed (dependency vuln scan skipped)
findings.detail: Install trivy to enable the --deep dependency vulnerability scan.

findings.title: [SUPPLY] 58 container image(s) without a digest pin
findings.detail: Pin images by digest (`image@sha256:...`) for reproducible, tamper-evident deploys.

findings.title: [SUPPLY] hadolint not installed (Dockerfile lint skipped)
findings.detail: Install hadolint to lint Dockerfiles in --deep mode.

findings.title: Vendored mct/compose images are unpinned under a blanket waiver
findings.note: Carried from focused run SUPPLY-P3-001 / DET-P3-007; still present at f9cb67d.
findings.recommendation: Scope the waiver to specific refs, add an explicit deploy-blocking guard for mct/compose, and remove or justify the docker.sock mounts.

findings.title: Vulnerability scan coverage for 12 images is stale/pending, gated only by expiring waivers
findings.note: Carried from focused run SUPPLY-P3-002; still present at f9cb67d.
findings.recommendation: Run `automation/validation/vuln-summary.sh` in the next patch window, refresh waivers to real dispositions, and add a scheduled scan job.

findings.title: Image/SBOM-component license allow/deny gate is not enforced
findings.note: Carried from focused run SUPPLY-P3-003; still present at f9cb67d.
findings.recommendation: Add `pins/licenses.allow` plus a check over `sbom/*.cdx.json` license fields (allow MIT/BSD/Apache/ISC; deny GPL/AGPL/LGPL/SSPL unless the self-hosted exception applies).
